title: nexus audit bundle v1
description: Generated from AuditBundleDocument in cli/src/audit_contract.ts by cli/scripts/gen_audit_schema.mjs. Do not edit by hand. A document of an audit bundle: manifest.json (AuditManifest), or the detached signature envelope manifest.sig.json (AuditSignatureEnvelope).

AuditBuildIdentity.description: The Nexus build that wrote the bundle.

AuditBundleDocument.description: A document of the bundle: the manifest, or the signature envelope.

AuditChainHead.description: The last link of a chain: the position of the last record and its hash.

AuditChainedLog.description: A payload file that is itself a hash-chained log (one JSON record per line), with what its chain read as at export.

closed.description: The log ended with its defined last record (a flight's `session_end`). False: still recording, stopped early, or cut.

head.description: The last record's link; present when the chain was intact and not empty.

path.description: The log's path in the bundle; it is also listed in `files`.

records.description: Number of records in the bundled log.

selection.description: How the log was chosen: named by the operator, or found by time window (a heuristic that can pick up another task's log).

status.description: What `verifyChain` reported for the bundled log at export. A log already broken or unchained is recorded as such, not hidden.

AuditChainedLogSource.description: The log a bundled excerpt was taken from, as it was when the bundle was written.

complete.description: The bundle holds the whole source log; false when it holds a prefix of it.

AuditFileEntry.description: One payload file of the bundle.

bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

chain.description: Link to the entry before this one (core/hash_chain.ts `linkRecord` over `{ path, bytes, sha256, role }`).

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the bundle: segments of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, never `.` or `..`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex.

AuditManifest.description:
`manifest.json`. On disk it is exactly `canonicalJson(manifest) + "\n"` (core/hash_chain.ts: keys sorted at every
depth, no whitespace), UTF-8; any other byte form is rejected, so the SHA-256 of the file is well defined.

bundle_id.description: 32 lowercase hex characters, random per bundle.

created_at.description: When the bundle was written (ISO 8601, UTC).

files.description: Every payload file, sorted by path, each linked to the one before it. `manifest.json` and `manifest.sig.json` are not listed.

files_head.description: The link of the last entry of `files`; null when there are none.

root_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of `canonicalJson` of this manifest without `root_sha256`, as UTF-8.

AuditOmitted.description: An artefact that was left out, and why.

AuditSignatureEnvelope.description:
`manifest.sig.json`, the detached signature. The signed bytes are AUDIT_SIGNATURE_DOMAIN followed by the exact bytes
of manifest.json. The public key is never in the bundle: a verifier checks against a key it already holds, and
`public_key_sha256` only helps name the key in messages.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the bytes of manifest.json.

public_key_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the signing key's public half, as SPKI DER.

at_rest.description: False when the subject could still be changing while it was exported.

store.description: The store the subject was read from.

workspace_path.description: The workspace as the task or session record names it: the string stored there, not resolved again at export.

workspace_sha256.description:
SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of the workspace path exactly as the task or session record holds it:
no `realpath`, no normalisation, no trailing separator added or removed, no newline. Bundles of one workspace can
so be matched when the path is withheld. When `workspace_path` is present this is the hash of that very string
(a bundle where the two disagree does not verify); null exactly when the record names no workspace.

hash.description: SHA-256 over `${seq}\n${prev}\n${canonicalJson(record without its chain)}`, hex.

prev.description: `hash` of the previous record; CHAIN_GENESIS for the first.
